ar: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
en: We sent it1down on the Night of Determination.
But what can make yousg realize what the Night of Determination is?
The Night of Determination is better than a thousand months—
in it descend the angels, with the Spirit1among them, by the leave of their Lord with every command.
Peace! It is until the rise1 of dawn.
